# processes

The executable half of this layer's methodologies -- `diig-investment-path.bpmn` renders DIIG's own nine chapters as a process with its two progress checks as gateways. A SEPARATE declaration from `methodologies/` even though it nests inside it, because `processes` and `methodology` are different graph typologies and a directory entry names one graph: the prose node says what the method IS, the diagram says how it RUNS. Bean `x4v4` raised whether `methodologies/` is a graph or a folder; this follows the shape already on main, where `methodology-crdm-processes` is declared beside `methodologies/` rather than inferred from it. Issue #877, bean `qnvy`.

Part of [SMART Base](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `processes`, holding `processes`.
